gloss: ability to execute; ability to get things done

definitions.gloss: ability to execute; ability to get things done; implementation ability
definitions.explanation: the ability to carry out plans, decisions, or ideas effectively

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{実行力|じっこうりょく}がある。
examples.english: He has the ability to get things done.

examples.japanese: リーダーには{実行力|じっこうりょく}が{求|もと}められる。
examples.english: Leaders are expected to have execution ability.

examples.japanese: アイデアはいいが、{実行力|じっこうりょく}に{欠|か}ける。
examples.english: The idea is good, but he lacks the ability to implement it.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
{実行|じっこう} (execution/implementation) + {力|りょく} (ability/power)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実行力|じっこうりょく}がある - to have execution ability
- {実行力|じっこうりょく}に{欠|か}ける - to lack execution ability
- {実行力|じっこうりょく}を{高|たか}める - to improve execution ability

BUSINESS CONTEXT:
Highly valued in business and leadership contexts. Often listed in job descriptions and performance evaluations.

RELATED ～{力|りょく} COMPOUNDS:
- {決断力|けつだんりょく} - decisiveness
- {行動力|こうどうりょく} - ability to take action
- {判断力|はんだんりょく} - judgment
